summary: Verified React 17 -> React 18 + ReactDOM.createRoot upgrade in the ClojureScript live-Reagent sandbox. All live Reagent previews (Hiccup, hiccup-from-data, state-atom counter, events-forms, todo-capstone) render, are reactive, and reuse a single root per preview across re-runs. ZERO React deprecation warnings, ZERO 'createRoot already called' warnings, ZERO console errors/warnings/pageerrors across the entire run. Plain snippet-run regression also clean.

detailed_results.console_diagnostics: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 pageerror events during the whole flow. Only 2 benign console.info messages, both the standard React DevTools nudge: '%cDownload the React DevTools for a better development experience: https://react.dev/link/react-devtools font-weight:bold'. NO 'ReactDOM.render is no longer supported' warning. NO 'You are calling ReactDOMClient.createRoot() on a container that has already been passed to createRoot() before' warning.

critical_code_review_comments: renderReagent() in src/lib/sci.js correctly creates the root once per mount id via a defonce'd __reagent_roots atom and re-uses it on subsequent .render calls — this is the right pattern for React 18 + Reagent-as-element and directly explains the absence of the double-createRoot warning.
reagentReady() now gates on window.ReactDOM.createRoot being a function AND reagent.core being requireable via Scittle — good defensive check for the CDN load-order.

Minor: __reagent_roots roots are never explicitly .unmount()'ed when ReagentSnippet unmounts. In the current app this is harmless because previews live for the lifetime of the page/lesson view; but if the routing model ever destroys the mount element, the retained root would hold a stale DOM ref. Consider a useEffect cleanup that calls (some-> root .unmount) via a small exposed helper.

The current uid counter for mountId is a module-level number that grows monotonically. Not a bug (each Snippet instance gets a unique id at construction), but be aware it never resets between hot reloads in dev; production is unaffected.
seed_data_creation: localStorage.clear() at run start to guarantee a fresh 0% state and to prevent any prior 100%-complete course-complete overlay from blocking navigation. No persistent seed retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: React 18 UMD + ReactDOM.createRoot + reagent.core/as-element rendering path is fully verified and clean. renderReagent() uses a cljs-side (defonce __reagent_roots (atom {})) keyed by mountId, so repeated Run clicks and re-navigation into the same lesson do NOT re-create roots and do NOT emit React deprecation warnings. If any future lesson introduces conditional un-mounting of a preview element, be sure to also .unmount() its stored root before the DOM node is removed, otherwise future re-mounts on a fresh element with the SAME mountId would surface the 'createRoot called twice' warning.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. The change under test (React 17 legacy render -> React 18 createRoot + reagent.core/as-element with a per-mount-id root registry) works exactly as designed.
